from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
p=Path('/workspace/product')
f=[x for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()]
print('Files by parent:', dict(Counter(str(x.parent.relative_to(p)) for x in f)))
print('Files by extension:',dict(Counter(x.suffix for x in f)))
print('AGENTS:',[str(x) for base in [Path('/workspace'),Path('/eval-home/.codex')] for x in base.glob('AGENTS.md')])
PY"
